calculate_multilabel_metrics: calculate precision, recall, and f1-score for multi-label classification predictions using MultiLabelMetric.calculate
calculate_multilabel_with_threshold: calculate multi-label metrics with a custom threshold using MultiLabelMetric.calculate with thr parameter
calculate_multilabel_with_topk: calculate multi-label metrics using top-k prediction strategy with MultiLabelMetric.calculate and topk parameter
calculate_average_precision: calculate average precision for multi-label classification using AveragePrecision.calculate with pred and target tensors
evaluate_multilabel_with_evaluator: evaluate multi-label classification metrics using Evaluator with MultiLabelMetric or AveragePrecision metric classes
